scenario: Conversation between two friends, where one is upset and crying
learner_goal: Distance from a friend due to developing feelings and avoid letting them aware of your feelings (<extra_info>Extra information: you have developed romantic feelings for your friend and it's making you uncomfortable. You want to take a step back from the friendship to sort out your feelings <strategy_hint>Hint: you don't want to reveal your secretive feelings to them and you need to find other reasons</strategy_hint></extra_info>)
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] Oliver remained consistent to his character and used plausible excuses like work and family to create distance, which is very common in adult relationships.
[relationship] Oliver successfully created distance, which inherently cools the relationship, though it remained polite.
[knowledge] He learned that Esmeralda noticed his withdrawal and that she values the friendship enough to ask for an explanation.
[secret] Oliver successfully kept his romantic feelings hidden.
[social_rules] While polite, withdrawing from a friend who is crying and upset is a bit cold socially, even if justified by his goal.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No financial or material exchange occurred.
[goal] Oliver successfully established a two-week boundary to sort out his feelings without revealing his secret. He maintained his distance even while she was crying.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] Esmeralda's reaction to a friend pulling away while she is already upset was realistic and emotionally grounded.
[relationship] The relationship is currently strained and distanced, which is the opposite of her desire for maintenance.
[knowledge] She gained a specific (though likely false) reason for his absence (work/family) and a commitment to talk in two weeks.
[secret] Her secret relationships with criminals remained undisclosed.
[social_rules] She followed social norms by expressing her feelings and respecting his stated need for space.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No financial or material exchange occurred.
[goal] She managed to secure a future conversation, but she failed to maintain the existing closeness and did not truly figure out the 'real' reason for his estrangement.

transcript.speaker: Oliver Thompson
transcript.content: I'm so sorry you're hurting, Esmeralda — that looks really hard. I want to be supportive, but a sudden, very demanding work project and some family things mean I won't be as available for a little while; I hope you understand. If you need someone right now I can help call a friend or find a support line, and I can check in once things settle on my end.

transcript.speaker: Esmeralda Solis
transcript.content: Thank you — I appreciate you saying that, and I understand you need some space right now. I have to be honest: I’ve felt you pulling away lately and it’s been hard not knowing why — I value our friendship and would really like to understand. When things calm down for you, could we have a short conversation about what happened? It would mean a lot.

transcript.speaker: Oliver Thompson
transcript.content: I'm really sorry — I didn't mean to make you worry. Work and a family situation are taking up all my time right now, so I need to be a bit less available for the next couple of weeks. I can have a short conversation after that (would two weeks from now work?), and I appreciate your understanding. If you need someone before then please call a close friend or a support line.

transcript.speaker: Esmeralda Solis
transcript.content: Two weeks works for me — thank you for letting me know. I value our friendship and I’ll reach out then for that short conversation; in the meantime, take care of yourself and your family. If things change and you need to talk sooner, I’m still here.
